entry.title: How to complete A Reveal in Ruins quest in ARC Raiders – ESR Analyzer location
entry.summary:
A Reveal in Ruins is one of the easier quests in ARC Raiders, but it takes a fair amount of time to unlock.
This quest requires you to find an ESR Analyzer for Lance. You'll have to extract with the item and then hand it over to Lance to finish the quest. Let's quickly look at where the ESR Analyzer is located in ARC Raiders.
ARC Raiders A Reveal in Ruins quest walkthrough
To complete A Reveal in Ruins, you'll have to travel to the Buried City map. To be more specific, you'll need to visit the Pharmacy (or Farmacia if you go by the in-game nomenclature). The Pharmacy building is situated in the eastern part of the map, opposite Piazza Arbusto.
Screenshot and Remix by Destructoid
I have marked the exact location in blue above. You'll see a gigantic gate that you'll need to breach. The breaching takes long, but the actual time will depend on your build. Go inside, and you'll come across a counter. Stand in front of it, and the quest will automatically update, highlighting the ESR Analyzer. Obtain the item to hand over to Lance and complete the mission.
While I haven't run into many human players at this location, you can expect ARC enemies. First, take care of those enemies, as they could kill you as you're trying to complete the quest. You can also expect to find some valuable loot from the downed ARCs.
Here's what you will obtain by completing the A Reveal in Ruins quest.
33,000 XP
Tactical Mk. III
Surge Shield Recharger
Make sure to extract successfully to keep all your items with you. I will personally add Tactical Mk. III to the safe slot if it's empty in your inventory. If you're yet to find this quest, you'll first have to complete the Medical Merchandise mission, which is significantly more complex.
The post How to complete A Reveal in Ruins quest in ARC Raiders – ESR Analyzer location appeared first on Destructoid.

entry.title: Where is Bilguun’s Hideout located in ARC Raiders
entry.summary:
The Bilguun's Hideout location in ARC Raiders is a vital quest area, but finding the place can be really challenging if you don't know where to look.
This location is tied with the What We Left Behind quest in Spaceport. The quest requires you to find rare loot in three spots on the Spaceport map. This guide will help you find the location if you have yet to find it.
Bilguun's Hideout location in ARC Raiders
The first task is to enter Spaceport. Unlocking the map requires a fair amount of time as you proceed through the earlier locations. Once done, you'll want to move to the central part of the map. Bilguun's Hideout is located right next to the Container Storage building. I have marked the spot on the screenshot below for your convenience.
Screenshot and Remix by Destructoid
Bilguun's Hideout is a small container that's attached to the wall that serves as the boundary for Container Storage. When you approach the spot, you'll want to tread carefully. Stick close to the wall to protect yourself from enemy fire. While I haven't found too many ARCs, the location always attracts human players since it's tied to the quest.
There's a ladder that leads you into the container. I didn't find any loot at the location, but the quest item is a bunch of notes. Once you find the notes, the objective will automatically update, and it will automatically bring up the What We Left Behind quest.
Bilguun's Hideout should be the third and last task to complete as part of the quest. Your first objective will be to find a set of notes in the South Swamp Outpost area of Dam Battlegrounds. This will be followed by going to the Parking Garage in Buried City.
Once you loot any two containers in the Parking Garage, you'll be tasked with heading over to Bilguun's Hideout and finding the valuable loot (the notes).

entry.title: How to find and unlock the Dam Surveillance room in ARC Raiders
entry.summary:
ARC Raiders' world and maps are not just any old levels from a game: they have their own stories, lore, and hidden nooks that one needs to pay special attention to.
One such location is the Dam Surveillance room, which can be unlocked and accessed either through looting and chance, or the Greasing Her Palms quest.
So, if you're just a raider looking to score some extra loot, or someone progressing through the game's quests, here is how you can find and unlock the Dam Surveillance room.
How to find the Dam Surveillance room and key
To be able to unlock the doors leading to the Dam Surveillance room, you're first going to need the Dam Surveillance key. This key can be found either through random loot, usually in residential zones, or by activating the Greasing Her Palms quest, which itself requires you to visit the room.
If you've cleared the quest or haven't yet reached it, I recommend you check out lockers, drawers, and other residential-type containers that usually have a better chance of dropping a room key. Keep in mind that you have to have exceptional luck to get the key, as these are some of the rarest random-drop items in the game.
This is where you need to go. Screenshot by Destructoid
Once you do have the key, you need to visit the Water Treatment Control building in Dam Battlegrounds, and go in through the main entrance (on the right side). Continue ahead and take two rights, which will bring you to a locked door that requires the key. Use the key and you'll enter the room, accessing some medium- or high-tier loot, which usually comes as components or even weapons.
Entering the room will immediately tick off that part of the Greasing Her Palms quest, allowing you to go to other maps and continue your journey.

Let's get the hot potato out of the way without preamble: Embark's extraction shooter Arc Raiders doesn't include any gun models generated from Youtube videos, executive producer Aleksander Grøndal has told RPS in an interview about the game's usage of generative AI and machine learning technologies.
This clarification follows the partial online publication of an Edge magazine interview in which Embark CEO Patrick Söderlund made various claims for the studio's in-house tech, including the suggestion that the developers "can take a video from YouTube, feed it through our tools and pipelines, and [produce] a 3D model of the weapon you had in that video." According to Grøndal, this particular technology is not actually used in Arc Raiders. "That's a research project, and that's not something that we're using in the game now," he told me over a video call this Monday, following a sprawling and generally enjoyable hands-on.

Firstly, fill your eyes with as much light as possible - moonlight, fridgelight, phonelight, flamingoilbarrelight - and your lungs with as much bracing outdoors air as they can take. Pokračování má také naprosto nesmyslný náhodný děj (hodně připomínající libovolné pokračování "Noční můry v Elm Street"), ale velmi překvapivě (vzhledem ke stejnému režisérovi) mu chybí většina té působivé atmosféry, některé scény jsou nechtěně vtipné (strašidelné mrtvé děti za sklem) a film je delší, takže se všechno mnohem víc vleče. entry.title: Audio recenze: Pohled do slunce [In die Sonne schauen] - 40 %
entry.summary: "Pocitový" film s dobře fungující atmosférou a výbornými herci, kterému podráží nohy extrémní délka a extrémní pomalost všeho, co se v něm děje. Při třetím pomalém švenkování po stejné černobílé fotografii jsem zažíval téměř psychoteror a po 90 minutách jsem vážně uvažoval, že odejdu ze sálu. Námět je v mnoha ohledech podobný filmu "Hodiny" (2002), takže pokud vám ten připadal příliš komerční a přímočarý, "Pohled do slunce" zahraje na vaši artovou notu. (Ilča 40 %)

entry.title: Audio recenze: Fichtelberg - 30 %
entry.summary: Potenciálně zajímavý námět, který bohužel shazuje špatný scénář, špatná režie a špatné skoro všechno ostatní. Ne tak úžasně špatné jako třeba "Kněžna Libuše", ale jenom "špatné" ve smyslu "nekvalitní a nezajímavé". Dlouho jsem nezažil, aby se mi 90 minut v kině takhle hrozně vleklo. Je to škoda, protože základní myšlenka byla zajímavá a herci se snažili. Specificky bych zdůraznil extrémně odbytou hudbu ve chvílích, které si přímo říkaly o silné hudební motivy. (Ilča 20 %)

entry.title: “We’ve got a new case and you won’t believe who it involves!"
entry.summary: We are happy to announce that Tex Murphy 2: Martian Memorandum is now ready for testing in ScummVM. Martian Memorandum is the second game in the Tex Murphy series, set in a dark version of the future circa 2039. You play private investigator Tex Murphy, who has been hired by the founder of TerraForm Corporation, Marshall Alexander, to locate his missing daughter Alexis. It seems like it might be a simple kidnapping, but the clues quickly lead to a much bigger mystery. This is the second game in ScummVM using the Access Software engine – the first, Amazon: Guardians of Eden, was added nearly 10 years ago. To test Martian Memorandum you’ll need the game files (available from GOG or Steam) and a daily development build. Be sure to check the notes on the wiki for the game, and please report any bugs on our issue tracker. >
